{{Quote|What's this? Now what have we got here? Some kind of porridge. You make this?|Noa Briqualon to Teek|<ref name="Ewoks">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref>}}
'''Porridge''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was once served porridge while visiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]], and the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]] made a pot of porridge while in the [[Noa Briqualon's hut|hut]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Noa Briqualon]].

==Description==
Porridge was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] served in a bowl. It was [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by members of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SW 64" />

==History==
In [[3960 BBY]], the hungry Human [[Jelph Marrian]] entered a [[Unidentified bar (Kesh)|bar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. There, [[Gender/Legends|he]] was served a bowl of porridge.<ref name="Sentinel">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Sentinel]]''</ref> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars (1977) 62|''Star Wars'' (1977) 62]] and the events of [[Star Wars (1977) 69|''Star Wars'' (1977) 69]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Since [[Star Wars (1977) 64|''Star Wars'' (1977) 64]] takes place in between those two [[Star Wars comic books|comics]], it also must take place in 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] traveled to the planet [[Serphidi/Legends|Serphidi]]. There, he visited the home of the [[Serp]] [[Elglih]] and his [[Elglih's wife|wife]], where he was served porridge that Elgih's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] had prepared in a pot. After Skywalker ate some of the porridge, the wife asked if he wanted any more, but Skywalker assured her that he had had enough.<ref name="SW 64" />

Also in 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="Date2">"[[Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline]]" dates the events of ''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]'', which include the appearance of porridge, to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]] made a pot of porridge on a stove while in the [[Noa Briqualon's hut|hut]] of the [[Hermit/Legends|hermit]] [[Noa Briqualon]]. when Briqualon found out that there were intruders in his home, he forced Warrick along with his Human friend, [[Cindel Towani]], to leave. Briqualon then found the porridge on the stove. He asked his companion, [[Teek (Teek)|Teek]], if he was the one who made it. Teek shook his head, and Briqualon offered him some of it. He also served some for himself.<ref name="Ewoks" />

==Behind the scenes==
Porridge first appeared in the [[Star Wars (1977) 64|sixty-fourth issue]] of the [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'' comic series]], which was written by [[David Michelinie]] and [[Michael Fleisher]], illustrated by [[Joe Brozowski]],<ref name="SW 64" /> and published on [[October 1]], [[1982]].<ref name="marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53854/star_wars_1977_64|text=Star Wars (1977) #64}}</ref>
